items.content_text: Peppermint oil may have a surprisingly powerful effect on blood pressure. items.title: ScienceDaily: New gum disease treatment kills bad bacteria while sparing the good
items.content_text: Researchers in Japan have developed an innovative gum disease treatment that uses egg yolk antibodies and near-infrared light to destroy harmful bacteria without harming beneficial microbes. Unlike conventional treatments, the approach preserves the mouth's natural bacterial balance and protects healthy gum cells. In mice, it significantly reduced the bone loss associated with periodontitis, a major cause of tooth loss.
